question: What happens when all things are forcefully offered into the fire of one's own awareness?
premises: All things are forcefully offered into the fire of one's own awareness.
By their own power they kindle that fire.
As a result they abandon the division of difference.
inference: When all phenomena are offered into innate awareness, they fuel that awareness and lose their apparent separateness.
plain_english: When all things are forcefully offered into the fire of one's own awareness, they kindle that fire by their own power and abandon the division of difference.
